look_here_first: On adult foliage, inspect the tiny scale leaves for a darker raised, nearly circular to hemispheric resin gland. Then confirm with dark-blue glaucous seed cones and thin shredding bark.

key_traits.label: Habit
key_traits.text: Evergreen dioecious shrub to small tree, often irregular to rounded and sometimes multistemmed.

key_traits.label: Bark
key_traits.text: Brown to gray bark exfoliating in thin fibrous or shredding strips.

key_traits.label: Leaves
key_traits.text: Adult leaves are tiny appressed scales; typical blades about 1 mm long with finely toothed margins and a darker raised circular resin gland. Vigorous whip shoots may carry longer awl-like leaves.

key_traits.label: Reproductive
key_traits.text: Pollen cones are small and terminal. Mature seed cones are berrylike, dark purplish-blue and glaucous, typically 6–9 mm and commonly one-seeded.
